records.observation: Merge iterator snapshots head from each floor root down tolowest, optional additional lowest-floor shadow stream. TreeMap uses requested Drawable comparator with Drawable keys and remaining iterator values; equal comparator keys replace iterator without collision handling, so streams can be lost if comparator returns0; actual equality conditions belong to comparator. Removes first map entry as active; next map first becomes competing head and its start/final border time. Empty map NoSuchElementException handled in two constructor regions with null heads/iterator and +/-Infinity sentinel; hasNext is active head nonnull. next saves active, clears it, advances active stream if possible; switch to competitor when competitor border < newactive for increasing, logical NOT of that comparison for decreasing (ties switch decreasing, ties stay increasing). Uses border only, not full comparator tiebreak, on this fast path. Switch removes competitor, reinserts new active and picks new map first. Exhausted active selects competitor and removes it. Broad NoSuchElementException catch across advancement/map operations resets competitor and sentinel but can mask child iterator failure and leave current null or partly advanced; initial empty next dereferences null iterator, after normal exhaustion can returnnull instead of required exception. No remove implementation. No sentinel-null guard before switch: decreasing stream with next border -Infinity and no competitor satisfies NOT(-Infinity < -Infinity), attempts map remove(null); valid finite data avoids this condition. NaN dcmpg result makes comparisonfalse, so decreasing also takes switch; no finite guards. Merges across floor streams but relies on each floor being sorted; does not repair node-order or composite iterator issues. No archived execution.
